'''Salporin'''<ref name="SWCT" /> was a [[Wookiee]] [[Wookiee warrior|warrior]] in the [[Kachirho Wookiee Militia]] in the [[Wookiee Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. He fought in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]], one of the final engagements of the [[Clone Wars]], a pan-galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The battle ended with the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] having turned on the [[Jedi]] due to the activation of [[Order 66]] by [[Darth Sidious]].<ref name="ROTS" /> In the aftermath of the battle, the newly formed [[Galactic Empire]] took the majority of the Wookiee population as [[Slavery|slaves]].<ref name="RebelsVG">''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Salporin wore [[armor]] upon the head and on the shoulders.<ref name="SWCT" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Salporin first appeared in {{Film|III}},<ref name="ROTS" /> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]],<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> where he was played by [[David Stiff]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|salporin|Salporin}}</ref> Salporin non-canonically appears as a CPU during multiplayer AI matches in the [[2017]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' as a Wookiee reinforcement for the Galactic Republic and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref> [[Salporin/Legends|Salporin]] was originally created by author [[Timothy Zahn]] for his [[1991]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Later, the official [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] Salporin to be one of the Wookiees seen fighting in ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="DB" /> The character was first [[canon]]ically named Salporin in [[2016]] by the [[Star Wars video games|mobile app]] ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]''.<ref name="SWCT" />

During the filming for ''Revenge of the Sith'', Stiff wore a Wookiee suit, and his movements were used as a model for several digitally created Wookiees featured in the movie.<ref name="DB" /> The scenes in which contained Salporin were filmed on Stage 2 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney|Fox Studios]] in [[Wikipedia:Sydney|Sydney]], [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]] during additional photography from [[May 17]]–[[May 18|18]] [[2004]].<ref name="Making Of">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Years after the release of the film, Salporin's costume was showcased in the ''[[Star Wars: Where Science Meets Imagination]]'' exhibit.<ref name="WSMI-File">[[:File:TarffulAndSalporin-OMSI.jpg|Tarfull and Salporin on showcase at the Star Wars: Where Science Meets Imagination exhibit]]</ref>

''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that the majority of the Wookiee population was enslaved after the Battle of Kashyyyk.<ref name="RebelsVG" /> Canonically, Salporin has yet to be established as part of this population. However, the non-canon show,<ref name="SWCE 2016">{{SW|url=news/swce-2016-lego-star-wars-the-freemaker-adventures-panel-liveblog|text=SWCE 2016: ''LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures'' Panel Liveblog}}</ref> ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' expanded on Salporin's capture in the episode ''[[Peril on Kashyyyk]]'', where his name was mentioned in [[Aurebesh]] on an Imperial prison directory.<ref name="PoK">{{FreemakerAdventures|Peril on Kashyyyk}}</ref>
